topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture's learning objectives and frames the discussion around the hallmarks of cancer and tumor progression models.

topics.label: Growth signaling deregulation and pathway mutations
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how mutations in signaling cascades, including Wnt and receptor tyrosine kinase pathways, drive sustained proliferation and cell survival.

topics.label: Block in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how cancer cells fail to execute normal terminal differentiation programs in both hematopoietic lineages and colorectal tissue.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: It details how mutations disrupting the p53 pathway and the balance of pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins enable cancer cells to resist programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and growth-control summary
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how telomere maintenance and p53-mediated stress pathways govern cellular senescence and replicative immortality before summarizing growth-control hallmarks.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: They describe how cancer cells rewire metabolic pathways through aerobic glycolysis and how metabolic enzyme mutations generate oncometabolites that drive tumorigenesis.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the requirement and regulatory balance for tumors to stimulate new blood vessel growth to sustain nutrient and oxygen supply.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dynamics, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: They examine the biological steps, environmental interactions, and genomic characteristics governing metastatic dissemination and colonization.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with summary remarks on cancer hallmarks and recommends supplementary reading.
